description: This file defines a PHP trait 'EntityManagerHelperTrait' that provides various helper methods for managing entities via Doctrine ORM. It includes functions for CRUD operations, query building, transaction management, and result retrieval, primarily for use within a Doctrine-based ORM context in a PHP application.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Returns a repository for the specified entity class, utilizing Doctrine's EntityManager.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Persists a given entity and flushes changes to the database.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a given entity and flushes the changes.

methods.name: createQueryBuilder
methods.description: Creates a Doctrine QueryBuilder for the specified entity class with an alias and optional index by.

methods.name: getPaginator
methods.description: Wraps a QueryBuilder in a Paginator object for paginated results.

methods.name: getQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Wraps a QueryBuilder in a QueryBuilderWrapper object.

methods.name: fetchOne
methods.description: Fetches a single object result from a QueryBuilder with an optional offset.

methods.name: getReference
methods.description: Obtains a reference to an entity by its class name and identifier without fully loading it.

methods.name: beginTransaction
methods.description: Starts a new database transaction via EntityManager connection.

methods.name: rollBackTransaction
methods.description: Rolls back the current database transaction.
